verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe an automatic incident timeline that aggregates updates from people, systems, automations, and communication channels into a chronological narrative (rootly-docs-12, rootly-docs-40, rootly-docs-50), and retrospectives/AI features draft sections like 'Curated Timeline' from Slack and bridge-call data (rootly-docs-13, rootly-docs-27), with a rich-text collaborative editor supporting annotation and editing post-hoc (rootly-docs-15, rootly-docs-28, rootly-docs-51). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the timeline capture is fully automatic and accurate in practice, and no explicit detail on granular manual annotation/editing controls beyond the retrospective editor.
